name: Operational DSU Guarantee
description: Replaces explicit graph properties (like m = n - 1 or acyclicity) with a description of how a Disjoint Set Union (DSU) based process behaves on the graph. By stating that a cycle-checking auditor would accept all m edges and connect all n nodes regardless of the evaluation order, it mathematically guarantees a tree structure while requiring the model to reason through the algorithm's execution to deduce the topology.
